candidates.name: grin_radial_smoke
candidates.reason: Canonical primary fixture. First Core smoke run. Foundation for all family comparisons.

candidates.name: grin_radial_smoke_variant
candidates.reason: Amplitude sensitivity variant (+20% field strength). Demonstrates measurable bend-magnitude increase. First amplitude variation in the library.

candidates.name: grin_radial_smoke_observer_variant
candidates.reason: Observer FOV eligibility variant (+1 degree). Confirms that observer basis shifts produce distinct ASCII patterns. Core eligibility test for observer variation.

candidates.name: grin_radial_smoke_resolution_variant
candidates.reason: Resolution eligibility variant (41x22 vs 40x22). Confirms Core CLI handles non-standard grid dimensions. Increases ray count to 902.

candidates.name: glowing_heart_grin_bridge
candidates.reason: Shared fixture metadata bridge. Schema definition only. Not runnable via CLI. Deferred to schema category.

candidates.name: glowing_heart_observer_target
candidates.reason: Observer target alignment contract. Not a runnable fixture. Deferred to schema/metadata category.

deferredCategories.reason: Require Godot runtime. Core CLI cannot load .tscn scene files. Deferred to future Core-implemented fixture families.
Schema/contract files only. Not runnable transport fixtures.

claimBoundary: All Godot-only fixtures deferred without prejudice.
